title: Review as Code Review Metadata
description: Optional machine-readable projection of a RaC review metadata file, derived per SPEC Section 15.1. Markdown remains the canonical human-readable format. Additional properties are permitted so repositories MAY extend the record.

status.description: Summary metadata only. MUST NOT be used to track individual finding workflow (SPEC Section 6).

base.description: Optional base reference, for example a commit or pull-request reference (SPEC Section 4).

rac_version.description: The RaC protocol version the record was written against.

closed_date.description: The date the review was closed.
